thread:
matt_support: FYI incoming P1 from support — 'Veridian Health' trial is blocked: SSO keeps throwing 500s during auth redirect and our embed iframe intermittently 504s. Customer pilot demo tomorrow, risk of losing renewal interest. Can CS pick this up as priority?

katie_cs: Thanks @matt_support — can you drop the error snippets and which org id + region? I'll start a comms plan and outreach cadence.

matt_support: Org: veridian-health (org_9081), region: eu-west-1. Latest error from proxy: 
```
ERROR: /auth/callback 500 InternalServerError - upstream connect failure
x-request-id: 8f3b2c
payload: SAMLResponse missing RelayState
```
Also seeing embed logs: 
```
iframe-load: 504 gateway timeout after 30s
url: https://embed.redwood.ai/v1/render?tenant=veridian-health
```

linh_se: Quick note — SAMLResponse missing RelayState usually means our axios redirect handler dropped query params when we proxied through the new edge. I can patch a safe fallback in the middleware in ~45m but need a quick config rollback on the edge to restore previous behavior if we want <30m mitigation.

jordan_pm: If they miss tomorrow's demo that's high-risk. Suggest immediate comms: 1) acknowledge within 15m, 2) offer workaround/demo on shared screen if embed unreliable, 3) schedule an owner-led call in 1 hour. Katie do you want me to join the call?

katie_cs: Yes please join @jordan_pm. Drafting outbound now — short, transparent, and positioning ops work. Proposed message: 
"Hi Sarah, we're sorry — we're investigating an authentication and embed issue affecting your demo. Our engineering lead is triaging now. We can (a) run the demo over screenshare at the scheduled time, or (b) reschedule to a time that works for you. We're prioritizing a patch and will update in 30 minutes. — Katie (Customer Success)"

matt_support: +1. Also asked support to open a live-support bridge so we can paste logs. ops-bot: incident created: INC-3051236789, severity: high.

linh_se: Patch ready, but rollback path is faster. If we rollback edge config: run `edgectl rollback --service auth-proxy --to 2023-11-02T14:00Z` and purge edge cache for tenant veridian-health: `edgectl purge --tenant veridian-health`. I'll be on the call to execute.

katie_cs: Comms plan (final):
- 0-15m: Send acknowledgement to Sarah + offer screenshare demo (owner: katie_cs).
- 15-45m: Engineering mitigation (rollback) OR patch deploy + smoke test (owner: linh_se, matt_support).
- 45-90m: Follow-up update to customer with ETA and confirmation of demo option (owner: katie_cs).
- If unresolved by 90m: propose reschedule + exec escalate (owner: jordan_pm).

katie_cs: Also capturing feedback/questions to route to product: are embeds resilient to missing RelayState? If not, can we add a defensive handler? @jordan_pm can you add to backlog with urgent labeling?

jordan_pm: Adding a spike to backlog and tagging priority: `embeds: defensive relaystate handling` — will assign to eng-ml triage after incident.

matt_support: Support note: flagged as renewable-risk signal in customer health (trial demo blocked). Set cs_priority=true on org meta.

ops-bot: incident INC-3051236789 updated: status -> mitigation in progress; assigned to linh_se.

katie_cs: Sent initial ack to Sarah at +5m. She accepted screenshare for demo. I'm joining the bridge at :10.

linh_se: Rolled back edge config at +22m, purged cache, running smoke now. Preliminary check: auth callback flows returning 200, embed loads stable in eu-west-1.

matt_support: Verified on support side, no 500s observed in last 5m. Pushing note to ticket and closing the urgent bridge after customer confirms demo.

katie_cs: Customer confirmed demo over screenshare and appreciated the quick turnaround. Follow-up scheduled for 24h to check adoption signal.

jordan_pm: Great — capture postmortem notes and timeline for retro. I'll own backlog item and link incident.

katie_cs: Final ask: I'll include raw customer feedback in the ticket thread for product research. Closing this Slack thread, will update if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
